description: After fz-sc8.63 a pattern = expr statement lowers as a decision whose single arm body is the rest of the block, so each = adds one lowered-body entry (the arm) on every path; fz-sc8.80 makes that arm a block on native at no cost, but the interpreter still transitions into it and every compile-time walk still visits it. When the trimmed plan is a lone outcome (graph root=n0 outcome o0: no test, nothing can fail) the arm's bindings are plain projections, and the arm can be spliced into the entry that holds the dispatch, giving zero extra entries. Trimming is per activation, so this decision belongs at backend time, not in body.rs. Measure first: entries_walked per walk is not observable from the CLI (the public trace filters *.walk events); either add the observation or compare lowered-body entry counts in a unit test, and A/B interp wall-clock on a =-heavy loop. End of epic; not on the distiller thread.
title: A decision whose trimmed plan is a lone outcome splices its arm into its entry
